## Trust review

- [ ] External input is runtime-validated.
- [ ] Raw source events remain immutable and capture gaps remain explicit.
- [ ] Findings reference concrete event IDs.
- [ ] No telemetry, upload, or network access was added by default.
- [ ] Imported trace content is never executed.
- [ ] Eval execution remains isolated from the active checkout.
- [ ] Security/privacy implications and release notes were considered.

## Scope

- [ ] No unrelated refactors or production dependencies are included.
- [ ] The diff is ready for review and all required checks pass.
